0.why: BPFCore.cc:34 divides this jack by 5V and BPFCore.cc:35 clamps the knob-plus-jack total between -1 and 1 before setPitchMultiple at math.hh:252 raises 2 to five times it, which is one octave per volt in both directions

1.why: BPFCore.cc:21 takes the voice count from this jack and BPFCore.cc:39 filters it per voice

0.why: BPFCore.cc:24 sets this output's channel count from the audio input

comment: The knob is configured over 261 to 1046 Hz (BPF_info.hh:19) and the maker's manual gives '261hz - 1041hz', but BPFCore.cc:51 turns the parameter into -1 to +1 and BPFCore.cc:35 multiplies 523.25Hz by two raised to five times it, which is 16.35Hz to 16744Hz. The manual has the two modes as Korg-style Standard and Oberheim, which the switch labels at BPF_info.hh:21 confirm.
